name: Back order arrangement type code
description: Code specifying a type of back order arrangement.

values.name: Back order only if new item (book industry - not yet
values.description: Back order only if new item (book industry - not yet published only) Item on back order due to unpublished status.

values.name: Factory ship
values.description: Factory ship Ship directly from factory to purchaser.

values.name: No back order
values.description: No back order Back order is unacceptable.

values.name: Warehouse ship
values.description: Warehouse ship Ship directly from warehouse.

values.name: Back order if out of stock
values.description: Back order if out of stock Acceptable to put on back order if out of stock.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Mutually defined A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
